section.content: 本实用新型涉及电池的技术领域，尤其是涉及一种锂离子电池，包括封装体和置于封装体内的电芯本体，所述电芯本体设有用于增加电子进出电芯本体的通道的导电体组件，所述导电体组件包括设置在电芯本体两侧的第一导电体和第二导电体，所述第一导电体折叠并与电芯本体和第二导电体接触。本实用新型设计科学合理，结构简单，与现有技术相比，第一导电体和第二导电体的设置，能够有效的增大电子进出电芯本体的通道，使得更多的电子能够同时进出电芯本体，以达到增大电芯本体充放电倍率的效果，从而提高电池的充放电倍率的性能。

The utility model belongs to the technical field of the technique of battery and specifically relates to a lithium ion battery is related to, including the packaging body and arrange the internal electric core body of packaging in, electric core body is equipped with the electric conductor subassembly that is used for increasing the passageway of electron business turn over electric core body, the electric conductor subassembly is including setting up first electric conductor and the second electric conductor in electric core body both sides, first electric conductor is folding and contact with electric core body and second electric conductor. The utility model has the advantages of being scientific and reasonable in design, simple structure compares with prior art, and the passageway that can effectual increase electron business turn over electric core body is passed in and out to the setting of first electric conductor and second electric conductor for more electrons can pass in and out electric core body simultaneously, in order to reach the effect of increase electric core body charge-discharge multiplying power, thereby improve the performance of the charge-discharge multiplying power of battery.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of the technique of battery and specifically relates to a lithium ion battery is related to.

Background

A battery refers to a device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy in a portion of the space of a cup, tank, or other container or composite container that holds an electrolyte solution and metal electrodes to produce an electrical current. Has a positive electrode and a negative electrode. With the advancement of technology, batteries generally refer to small devices that can generate electrical energy. The battery comprises a lithium ion battery, and the lithium ion battery comprises a soft package lithium ion battery.

The conventional soft package lithium ion battery is prepared into a battery cell by a lamination or winding method, wherein the lamination soft package lithium ion battery is formed by stacking N positive plates, N +1 negative plates and diaphragms spaced between each positive plate and each negative plate. The N positive plates and the N +1 negative plates lead out metal foil conductors and are welded with corresponding positive and negative electrode tabs to form a current collecting conductor to output current outwards. At present, only one metal foil conductor is led out from a single common positive plate or negative plate and is designed on the same end face in the width direction of the battery cell side by side, the width of a positive lug and a negative lug is limited by the width of the battery cell, the width of the positive lug and the negative lug cannot be designed to be too wide when the width of the lugs is designed, otherwise, the distance between the positive lug and the negative lug is too small, the positive lug and the negative lug are easy to contact or even overlap in the production or use process, and short circuit occurs, so that safety.

From the above, the usable width of the electrode lug in the battery cell with a specific size is very limited, the limited electrode lug width restricts the high-rate and high-current charge and discharge current, the surface temperature of the battery is possibly too high, the high-rate discharge performance is influenced, and the maximum charge and discharge rate of the battery is limited.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at providing a simple structure's lithium ion battery, lithium ion battery adopt the bipolar ear setting, have effectively increased electron business turn over lithium ion battery's passageway to let more electrons business turn over lithium ion battery simultaneously, reach the effect that increases battery charge and discharge multiplying power.

The above utility model discloses an above-mentioned utility model purpose can realize through following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, includes the packaging body and arranges the electric core body in the packaging body in, electric core body is equipped with the electric conductor subassembly that is used for increasing the passageway of electron business turn over electric core body, electric conductor subassembly is including setting up first electric conductor and the second electric conductor in electric core body both sides, first electric conductor is folding and with electric core body and second electric conductor contact.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the passageway of electric core body is passed in and out to the setting of first electric conductor and second electric conductor, can effectual increase electron for more electrons can pass in and out electric core body simultaneously, in order to reach the effect of increase electric core body charge-discharge multiplying power, thereby improve the performance of the charge-discharge multiplying power of battery. The first electric conductor is folded and is contacted with the battery cell body and the second electric conductor, so that the battery cell body is more compact, and the battery is more compact.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the length of the first electric conductor is not less than the length of the second electric conductor and the length of the battery cell body.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme to first electric conductor after being convenient for folding can contact with the second electric conductor.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the first electric conductor is respectively attached to the battery cell body and the second electric conductor, and the first electric conductor and the second electric conductor are welded and fixed with the tabs.

By adopting the technical scheme, the passage for the electrons to enter and exit the lithium ion battery is increased, and meanwhile, the battery cell body is more compact, so that the battery is more compact.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the two groups of the conductor assemblies are respectively positioned on one side and/or two sides of the electric core body; and/or both sets of said electrical conductor assemblies are preferably arranged vertically.

By adopting the technical scheme, the arrangement mode of the electric conductor component on the electric core body is enriched, so that different batteries can be prepared according to different requirements.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the battery cell body comprises at least two layers of pole pieces and a plurality of diaphragms which are overlapped together, the diaphragms are positioned between the two layers of pole pieces, and the diaphragms are attached to the surface of one layer of pole piece, which deviates from the other layer of pole piece.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the diaphragm is located between two-layer pole piece, and the surface that the diaphragm laminating one deck pole piece deviates from the other deck pole piece to the contact of two-layer pole piece is restricted, is favorable to the battery normal work.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the electric conductor assembly comprises a first electric conductor and a second electric conductor which are arranged on two sides of the pole piece, and the length of the first electric conductor is not less than that of the second electric conductor and the pole piece.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, the length of first electric conductor is greater than the length of second electric conductor and pole piece to in folding first electric conductor, make first electric conductor and the laminating of second electric conductor.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the first conductor is folded and is in contact with the diaphragm and the second conductor, and the first conductor and the second conductor are welded and fixed with the tabs.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme to electron business turn over electric core body through utmost point ear, first electric conductor and second electric conductor.

The utility model discloses further set up to: electrolyte is filled in the packaging body, and the electrolyte is soaked between the diaphragm and the pole piece.

By adopting the technical scheme, the electrolyte is soaked between the diaphragm and the pole pieces so as to facilitate the lithium ions to move back and forth between the pole pieces.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the pole pieces comprise n layers of positive pole pieces and n +1 layers of negative pole pieces, and the positive pole pieces are positioned between the two layers of negative pole pieces; the pole pieces preferably comprise a layer of positive pole piece and at least one layer of negative pole piece, the surfaces of the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece are correspondingly arranged, and the diaphragm is positioned between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece.

The utility model discloses further set up to: the first conductor and the second conductor are located on the same straight line.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme for laminating of first electric conductor and second electric conductor after folding reduces safe risk, makes things convenient for first electric conductor and second electric conductor and utmost point ear welded fastening.

To sum up, the utility model discloses a beneficial technological effect does:

1. the utility model has scientific and reasonable design and simple structure, compared with the prior art, the arrangement of the first electric conductor and the second electric conductor can effectively increase the passage for the electrons to pass in and out the electric core body, so that more electrons can pass in and out the electric core body simultaneously to achieve the effect of increasing the charging and discharging multiplying power of the electric core body, thereby improving the performance of the charging and discharging multiplying power of the battery;

2. the battery cell body comprises a positive plate and a negative plate, and the first electric conductor and the second electric conductor are arranged on two sides of the positive plate and the negative plate so as to facilitate the lifting of a channel for electrons to enter and exit the positive plate and the negative plate and enable more electrons to enter and exit the positive plate and the negative plate simultaneously, thereby improving the charge and discharge multiplying power of the positive plate and the negative plate, further improving the charge and discharge multiplying power of the battery cell body and being beneficial to optimizing the charge and discharge multiplying power performance of a battery;

3. the first electric conductor is folded and is attached to the second electric conductor, the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, so that the positive plate, the negative plate and the diaphragm can be spliced into the electric core body, the assembly of the battery is simplified, and the work efficiency is improved;

4. the metal foil for preparing the positive plate and the negative plate is very thin (the width of the positive plate and the width of the negative plate are far smaller than that of the battery cell body), the first conductor is folded and is in contact with the second conductor, the influence on the thickness of the battery cell body is not large, so that the internal resistance of the battery cell body is reduced, the discharge voltage is increased, the heat production quantity of the battery is reduced, and the charge-discharge multiplying power of the battery is increased.

Detailed Description

The present invention will be described in further detail with reference to the accompanying drawings.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, in order to the utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a packaging body 1 and a cell body 2 arranged in the packaging body 1, the cell body 2 is provided with two sets of electric conductor components 3, one set of electric conductor component 3 is a positive electrode, the other set of electric conductor component 3 is a negative electrode, the electric conductor component 3 is used for increasing the passage of electrons into and out of the cell body 2, and one end of the electric conductor component 3 away from the cell body 2 is fixed with a tab 4; in this embodiment, the package body 1 includes an aluminum-plastic film, and the aluminum-plastic film is wrapped on the surface of the battery cell body 2; when the battery is packaged, the cpp glue of the inner layer of the aluminum-plastic film is fixedly welded with the tab glue 41 on the tab 4 by heating, so that the aluminum-plastic film and the tab 4 are fixed, and the sealed packaging of the battery cell body 2 is realized. Electrolyte is filled in the aluminum-plastic film and permeates into the cell body 2;

the conductor assembly 3 comprises a first conductor 31 and a second conductor 32, the first conductor 31 and the second conductor 32 are arranged on two sides of the cell body 2 to increase the passage of electrons into and out of the cell body 2, and the first conductor 31 and the second conductor 32 are positioned on the same straight line; the first conductor 31 and the second conductor 32 have the same width, the length of the first conductor 31 is greater than that of the second conductor 32, and the length of the first conductor 31 is not less than that of the second conductor 32 and the cell body 2. The first conductor 31 is folded and attached to the cell body 2 and the second conductor 32, so that the cell body 2, the first conductor 31 and the second conductor 32 are arranged more compactly; the first electric conductor 31 and the second electric conductor 32 are welded and fixed with the tab 4, so that the electric core body 2 can conduct current by using the tab 4, and the middle part of the tab 4 is adhered with an insulated tab 4 glue to improve the safety coefficient of the tab 4, thereby improving the safety coefficient of the battery;

referring to fig. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6, two sets of conductor assemblies 3 may be located on one side of the cell body 2, at this time, two sets of first conductors 31 are located on one side of the cell body 2, and two sets of first conductors 31 may also be located on two sides of the cell body 2, respectively; the two groups of conductor assemblies 3 may also be located on opposite sides of the cell body 2, at this time, the two groups of first conductors 31 are located on one side of the cell body 2, and the two groups of first conductors 31 may also be located on two sides of the cell body 2, respectively; two sets of electric conductor assemblies 3 are located the both sides of electric core body 2 respectively, and two sets of electric core bodies 2 set up perpendicularly, and at this moment, two sets of first electric conductors 31 can also be located the two sides of electric core body 2 respectively.

The battery core body 2 comprises at least two layers of stacked pole pieces and a plurality of diaphragms 7, the diaphragms 7 are positioned between the two layers of pole pieces so as to separate the two layers of pole pieces, the diaphragms 7 are attached to the surfaces of one layer of pole piece, which are far away from the other layer of pole piece, and the pole pieces comprise positive pole pieces 5 and negative pole pieces 6; the cell body 2 can also comprise at least three layers of stacked pole pieces and a plurality of diaphragms 7, wherein the pole pieces comprise n layers of positive pole pieces 5 and n +1 layers of negative pole pieces 6, one layer of positive pole piece 5 is positioned between two adjacent layers of negative pole pieces 6, and the diaphragms 7 are positioned between the positive pole pieces 5 and the negative pole pieces 6 so as to separate the positive pole pieces 5 from the negative pole pieces 6; the diaphragm 7 is attached to the surface of the negative plate 6 departing from the positive plate 5, that is, the battery cell body 2 at least comprises the diaphragm 7, the negative plate 6, the diaphragm 7, the positive plate 5, the diaphragm 7, the negative plate 6 and the diaphragm 7 which are arranged in sequence.

The conductor assembly 3 comprises a first conductor 31 and a second conductor 32 which are arranged on two sides of the pole piece, the length of the first conductor 31 is greater than that of the second conductor 32, the length of the first conductor 31 is not less than that of the second conductor 32 and the pole piece, and the first conductor 31 and the second conductor 32 are on the same straight line; the positive plate 5 and the negative plate 6 are directly cut by a grinding tool, so that the processing technology is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

Sequentially attaching the diaphragm 7, the negative electrode sheet 6, the diaphragm 7, the positive electrode sheet 5, the diaphragm 7, the negative electrode sheet 6 and the diaphragm 7, and folding the first conductor 31 to enable the first conductor 31 to be in contact with the diaphragm 7 and the second conductor 32; the first conductor 31 and the second conductor 32 are welded and fixed to the tab 4, and the first conductor 31 and the second conductor 32 are fixed. The aluminum plastic film is wrapped on the surfaces of the first conductor 31, the second conductor 32 and the diaphragm 7, and the first conductor 31, the second conductor 32, the diaphragm 7 and the aluminum plastic film are fixed by the tab 4 glue and the cpp glue through thermal welding. The aluminum-plastic film is filled with electrolyte, and the electrolyte is soaked among the diaphragm 7, the positive plate 5 and the negative plate 6.

The implementation principle of the embodiment is as follows: set up first conductor 31 and second conductor 32 in pole piece both sides corresponding position, first conductor 31 and second conductor 32 increase electron business turn over pole piece passageway for the pole piece can be simultaneously through more electrons, thereby increases the charge-discharge multiplying power of electric core body 2, and then increases the charge-discharge multiplying power of battery, is favorable to optimizing the performance of battery. The pole piece includes positive plate 5 and negative pole piece 6, and the foil material of preparation positive plate 5 and negative pole piece 6 is very thin (the width of positive plate 5 and negative pole piece 6 is far less than the width of electric core body 2), and first electric conductor 31 is folding and is little to the thickness influence of electric core body 2 with the contact of second electric conductor 32 to in reduce the internal resistance of electric core body 2, promote discharge voltage, reduce the heat production of battery, thereby promote the charge-discharge rate of battery.

In order to better demonstrate the advantages of the patent, the patent provides detection data of the battery of the technical scheme of the patent and the existing technical scheme, wherein the technical scheme of the patent adopts 5543085-10C-2850mAh battery to perform an experiment with the existing battery, the internal resistance of the battery is detected, and the experimental result is as follows in table 1:

It can be seen that the internal resistance of the experimental group was lower than that of the normal group, and the internal resistance of the experimental group was reduced by 9.2% relative to that of the normal group.

The test was continued for additional data for the experimental and normal groups, and the results are shown in table 2 below:

It can be seen that the battery rate discharge of the pack is achieved with a high median voltage and a low discharge temperature.

The embodiment of this specific implementation mode is the preferred embodiment of the present invention, not limit according to this the utility model discloses a protection scope, so: all equivalent changes made according to the structure, shape and principle of the utility model are covered within the protection scope of the utility model.
